items.name: layered-panel
items.title: Layered Panel
items.description: Right-hand peek panel that expands in place to a two-column detail view. No route change. Optional Next.js URL sync keeps Back working: full collapses to peek, then closes. Ships no theme, cssVars, or global CSS — it uses the host project's shadcn tokens and primitives.
items.author: Eduardo Retana

meta.descriptionEs: Panel de detalle que se abre a la derecha y crece en el mismo lugar hasta dos columnas. La ruta no cambia, así que la tabla conserva el scroll.

examples.title: Directorio del equipo
examples.description: Tabla densa. Un clic abre el peek y otro expande el perfil.

examples.title: Lead de CRM
examples.description: La misma pieza con etiquetas en español.

meta.usage:
Record

 Summary Full record

api.name: open
api.description: Controlled open state.

api.name: onOpenChange
api.description: Called when the dialog asks to open or close.

api.name: mode
api.description: Controlled disclosure mode.

api.name: onModeChange
api.description: Called when the panel switches between peek and full.

api.name: peekWidth
api.description: Desktop peek width. Any single CSS length. Default 26.25rem.

api.name: fullWidth
api.description: Desktop expanded width. Default 70vw.

api.name: closeLabel
api.description: Accessible name of the close button. Default Close.

api.name: mobilePeekLabel / mobileFullLabel
api.description: Tab labels below 1024px. Defaults Overview and Profile.

api.name: className and slot classes
api.description: overlayClassName, closeClassName, tabsClassName, tabClassName, gridClassName, plus className on every compound part.

api.name: LayeredPanel.Peek / Full
api.description: Peek stays on the right. Full is the left column and stays hidden until mode is full.

api.name: LayeredPanel.ExpandToggle
api.description: expandLabel and collapseLabel. Defaults View full profile and Close profile.

api.name: DetailSection / DetailField
api.description: Uppercase section label and a field row with optional icon, value, and href.

api.name: useLayeredPanelUrlState
api.description: Optional Next.js hook. ?member=id opens peek. &view=full expands. Back collapses, then closes.

items.docs: Import LayeredPanel from the installed UI file. URL sync is a separate hook (use-layered-panel-url-state) and is the only file that imports next/navigation. Below 1024px the panel is a full-screen sheet with tabs. The item declares button, scroll-area, and separator as registryDependencies and does not vendor copies. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite those files. No cssVars.

items.author: Eduardo Retana
items.name: admin-utils
items.title: Admin utilities
items.description: Slug, reorder, CSV, date range, and analytics helpers for an admin that does not care which router or database the host uses.

meta.descriptionEs: Slug único, reordenación, CSV, rango de fechas y resumen de analítica. Sin router ni base de datos.

examples.title: Slug y orden
examples.description: Un título en español se vuelve slug, y tres filas suben o bajan.

api.name: slugify / uniqueSlug
api.description: ASCII slug. uniqueSlug appends -2, -3 until free.

api.name: moveItem / reorderRows
api.description: Move one index, or rewrite position from an id list.

api.name: reorderVisible
api.description: Permute only the visible ids. Hidden ids keep their slots.

api.name: keepPosition
api.description: On save, keep the stored position of an existing row.

api.name: toCsv / downloadCsv
api.description: RFC-style CSV and a browser download.

api.name: resolveRange / presetBounds
api.description: Timezone-aware windows. Default UTC.

api.name: summarizeAnalytics
api.description: Views and clicks into daily, sources, funnel, scroll, and a Monday-first heatmap.

api.name: useOptimisticList
api.description: Show the next order immediately and roll back if onReorder rejects.

api.name: useUnsavedChanges
api.description: beforeunload guard while dirty is true.

api.name: useDateRange
api.description: Holds a range key and its resolved bounds.

items.docs: Copy the lib and hook files. Nothing here imports Next or Supabase. See NOTICE for the filtered-reorder attribution.

items.author: Eduardo Retana
items.name: admin-shell
items.title: Admin shell
items.description: Collapsible shadcn sidebar, breadcrumbs from one nav config, a command palette, and a theme toggle that uses the host controller when you pass one.

meta.descriptionEs: Barra lateral que se pliega a iconos, migas de pan, paleta de comandos y tema. Los enlaces los pone el anfitrión.

examples.title: Estudio Acme
examples.description: Tres pantallas en memoria. Cmd+K busca. El tema cicla claro, oscuro y sistema.

api.name: groups
api.description: Sidebar groups. Each item has href, label, and a lucide icon.

api.name: pathname / onNavigate
api.description: The host owns the route. No next/link import.

api.name: linkComponent
api.description: Optional anchor replacement. Defaults to <a>.

api.name: themeController
api.description: Pass next-themes useTheme(). Without it, the shell toggles the dark class.

api.name: actions
api.description: Slot in the top bar, before the theme button.

api.name: breadcrumbsFor
api.description: Crumbs derived from the same nav config.

items.docs: Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite button, breadcrumb, command, or sidebar. Pass themeController from next-themes so the shell does not fight the host provider.

items.author: Eduardo Retana
items.name: sortable-list
items.title: Sortable list
items.description: Mouse and keyboard drag list with screen-reader announcements, move buttons, a position number, and optimistic reorder that rolls back.

meta.descriptionEs: Arrastre con ratón y teclado, anuncios para lector de pantalla, botones de mover y reordenación optimista con deshacer.

examples.title: Cuatro proyectos
examples.description: Marca la casilla para ver cómo el orden vuelve atrás si el guardado falla.

api.name: items
api.description: id, title, optional meta and thumbnail.

api.name: visibleIds
api.description: Reorder only these ids. Hidden rows keep their slots.

api.name: onReorder
api.description: Reject to roll the list back. A toast reports the error.

api.name: onEdit
api.description: Edit button. The list does not open a form itself.

items.docs: dnd-kit PointerSensor and KeyboardSensor. Announcements are in English by default; labels are props. Filtered reorder is attributed in NOTICE.

items.author: Eduardo Retana
items.name: sortable-board
items.title: Sortable board

api.name: onReorder
api.description: Full id order, including rows hidden by the filter.

api.name: onToggleHomepage
api.description: Optimistic switch. Rejects roll the switch back.

api.name: view / query / filter

items.docs: The board does not know about a database. Pass the callbacks from your adapter.

api.name: ConfirmDelete / EmptyState / AdminSection

items.author: Eduardo Retana
items.name: admin-charts
items.title: Admin charts
items.description: KPI card with delta and sparkline, area trend with a range control, funnel, ranked bars, a day-by-hour heatmap, and a scroll-depth chart. Accent colors come from a tone mapped to chart-1…5.

meta.descriptionEs: Tarjeta con tendencia, área, embudo, barras, mapa de calor y profundidad de scroll. El acento es un tono chart-N.

examples.title: Semana de Acme
examples.description: Cifras ficticias. El selector cambia el rango activo.

<TrendChart points={points} range={range} onRangeChange={setRange} ranges={ranges} />

api.name: tone
api.description: Maps to bg-chart-N and var(--chart-N). The host theme defines the color.

api.name: StatCard
api.description: Value, percent delta, optional sparkline.

api.name: TrendChart
api.description: Area chart. visitorsLabel, viewsLabel, and rangeLabel override the series and range-group names. Range buttons are optional.

api.name: FunnelChart / RankedBars
api.description: Proportional bars. No extra chart theme.

api.name: Heatmap
api.description: 7×24 grid, Monday first. dayLabels overrides Mon–Sun.

api.name: ScrollDepthChart
api.description: Ratios from 0 to 1 render as percents.

items.docs: Charts read the host --chart-1 through --chart-5 tokens. No hex colors ship with the item.

items.name: supabase-admin
items.title: Supabase admin adapter
items.description: Typed adapter for the admin ports. The host passes in @supabase/supabase-js. Includes SQL for content tables, RLS, and a media bucket. This item does not connect to a database.

meta.descriptionEs: Listar, reordenar, guardar, borrar, subir a Storage y leer textos. El cliente lo crea el anfitrión. Incluye la migración SQL.

examples.title: Cómo conectarlo
examples.description: Instalación, Next.js, Vite y las políticas. Sin base de datos en este repo.

api.name: createSupabaseAdmin
api.description: Content, settings, media, and bookings. plans.list attaches plan_features.

api.name: createSupabaseSettings / createSupabaseMedia
api.description: Use one port on its own.

api.name: 001_admin_content.sql
api.description: Tables, is_admin(), RLS, and the media bucket. Apply it in the host project.

items.docs: Public read is limited to published rows. settings and media are public reads. bookings are admin-only. Writes require a row in public.admins. See admin-kit.md for Next.js and Vite wiring.
